tools.name: agent_status
tools.description: Use this when you need to verify that the Enterprise Master Agent is online.

tools.name: agent_capabilities
tools.description: Use this before planning work that may require local, data, RPA, workflow, or delegated capabilities.

tools.name: enterprise_semantic_resolve
tools.description: Use this to map Persian organizational language to canonical business semantics.

tools.name: enterprise_query_plan
tools.description: Use this to select the fastest safe data path; production read-only must remain last resort.

tools.name: agent_execute_local_shell
tools.description: Use this only for guarded execution on the local workstation. Never target the production server.

tools.name: agent_require_capability
tools.description: Use this when a required capability is missing. It checkpoints the task and returns the exact capability gap for owner approval.

tools.name: remote_server_performance_readonly
tools.description: Use this only for owner-approved read-only diagnostics of an allowlisted Windows server. It reads fixed CPU, RAM, paging, disk, network and process telemetry only; no arbitrary command or mutation is available.

tools.name: wol_generate_script
tools.description: Use this to generate, never execute, a Wake-on-LAN PowerShell script for manual server-side execution by the owner.

tools.name: knowledge_import
tools.description: Import one approved local Markdown ZIP as verified, versioned, read-only knowledge. This never installs or overwrites skills.

tools.name: knowledge_status
tools.description: Read the active knowledge version and the verified import history.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Search the active imported knowledge without activating captured skills.

tools.name: knowledge_rollback
tools.description: Activate a previously verified knowledge version without deleting content. Use only after explicit owner approval.

tools.name: skill_catalog
tools.description: List specialist skills installed for Negin Agents. Use this when you need to discover which domain or engineering skills are available before performing specialist work.

tools.name: skill_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a user task to the most relevant Negin specialist skills. Use this before specialist engineering or enterprise work, then load the selected skill with skill_get.

tools.name: skill_get
tools.description: Load the full SKILL.md instructions for one exact installed Negin skill. Use after skill_resolve or skill_catalog and follow the returned workflow and guardrails.

tools.name: integrations_health
tools.description: Check live local ClickHouse, n8n, and RPA capability health.

tools.name: clickhouse_query
tools.description: Run a read-only analytical ClickHouse query on the local enterprise analytics plane.

tools.name: sql_readonly_health
tools.description: Verify live SQL connectivity for Negin_Report_ReadOnly; the agent independently enforces no-write SQL even if legacy object grants exist.

tools.name: sql_readonly_query
tools.description: Run arbitrary bounded SELECT/CTE SQL using the Negin_Report_ReadOnly identity. Agent guard blocks writes, DDL, EXEC, comments, multi-statements, USE, INTO and DBCC.

tools.name: sql_deep_intelligence
tools.description: Bounded deep readonly SQL intelligence for catalog, relationships, dependencies, definitions, permission inventory, or per-table sampling.

tools.name: varanegar_item_latest_pricing
tools.description: Return the latest bounded pricing history for one Varanegar goods code across verified sale, customer-price, buy-price, ICA buy-price and pricing-wizard tables. Strict production read-only approval gate remains mandatory.

tools.name: varanegar_schema_search
tools.description: Search the live Varanegar/NeginPakhsh SQL catalog by table, schema or column keywords without scanning business data. Use this before building a new domain query.

tools.name: varanegar_domain_discovery
tools.description: Discover verified Varanegar schema objects for a business domain before querying it. Supported domains: sales, purchase, inventory, warehouse, treasury, banking, discounts, offers, tax, pricing, accounting, customer, supplier, hr.

tools.name: varanegar_readonly_query
tools.description: Run a bounded read-only SELECT/CTE against the verified Varanegar NeginPakhsh database after schema discovery. Writes, DDL, EXEC, comments, multi-statements, USE, INTO and DBCC remain blocked.

tools.name: system_performance_triage
tools.description: Diagnose local workstation CPU, RAM, paging, disk, network and runaway-process pressure without making changes.

tools.name: mcp_transport_diagnostics
tools.description: Diagnose Core, MCP Bridge, listener ownership and Tailscale Serve/Funnel transport without mutation.

tools.name: api_intelligence_scan
tools.description: Discover local API routes, MCP tools, auth signals and API specs with secret redaction. Production SQL is never used by this skill.

tools.name: capability_truth_contract
tools.description: Audit registered capabilities against executable MCP exposure. Use before claiming a new capability is active.

tools.name: task_universal_verifier
tools.description: Verify task completion from explicit postconditions and evidence. A task is not complete when required assertions fail or are absent.

tools.name: shell_checked_sequence
tools.description: Execute local shell work as independently verified steps so one successful final command cannot hide an earlier failed command.

tools.name: benchmark_regression
tools.description: Run the fixed Negin regression suite inside the project virtual environment and persist evidence.

tools.name: tool_reliability_report
tools.description: Read structured route reliability telemetry including success rate, verification rate and p50/p95 latency. Request/response bodies and secrets are never stored.

tools.name: n8n_workflow_manage
tools.description: Manage local n8n workflow lifecycle through authenticated API with validation and safety gates.

tools.name: n8n_webhook
tools.description: Execute a local n8n webhook workflow and recheck n8n after execution.

tools.name: rpa_list_windows
tools.description: List visible local workstation windows before choosing an RPA target.

tools.name: rpa_click_control
tools.description: Click one explicitly named UI control in one explicitly matched local workstation window.

tools.name: rpa_type_text
tools.description: Type explicit text into one explicitly named UI control in one explicitly matched local workstation window.

tools.name: continuous_runtime_status
tools.description: Check durable non-stop execution worker, queue, checkpoint/retry and crash-recovery health.

tools.name: continuous_submit_job
tools.description: Submit a whitelisted durable background job. Jobs persist across agent restarts and can retry until success.

tools.name: continuous_jobs
tools.description: List recent durable jobs.

tools.name: continuous_job_status
tools.description: Read one durable job including checkpoint and recent events.

tools.name: continuous_job_control
tools.description: Pause, resume or cancel a durable job.

tools.name: code_x_status
tools.description: Check Code-X runtime and source status.

tools.name: code_x_route_task

tools.name: code_x_handoff_to_negin
tools.description: Create a structured handoff packet for Negin Agent v4 without making a network call.

tools.name: code_x_skill_get

tools.name: code_x_repo_search

tools.name: code_x_repo_read

tools.name: code_x_shell_checked_sequence
tools.description: Run guarded local coding/build/test commands as independently verified steps.

tools.name: code_x_exec_start
tools.description: Start a safe detached durable shell job and return immediately.

tools.name: code_x_exec_status
tools.description: Read durable detached job status, heartbeat and watchdog metadata.

tools.name: code_x_exec_logs
tools.description: Read bounded stdout/stderr tails for a durable detached job.

tools.name: code_x_exec_cancel
tools.description: Cancel only a process tree owned by the Code-X remote execution registry.

tools.name: code_x_exec_session_open
tools.description: Open a guarded runtime-local interactive PowerShell or CMD session.

tools.name: code_x_exec_session_write
tools.description: Write one validated command to a Code-X-owned interactive shell session.

tools.name: code_x_exec_session_read
tools.description: Read bounded buffered output from a runtime-local interactive shell session.

tools.name: code_x_exec_session_close
tools.description: Close only a Code-X-owned interactive shell session.

tools.name: code_x_verify
tools.description: Verify completion from explicit assertions and evidence.

tools.name: code_x_coding_task
tools.description: Run a coding task with the configured Codex engine and existing Codex/ChatGPT login.

tools.name: code_x_session_resume
tools.description: Resume a Codex session in a validated workspace.

tools.name: code_x_session_steer
tools.description: Queue instructions for an existing Codex session, including during an active turn.

tools.name: code_x_job_submit
tools.description: Create a durable local Code-X job record for a supported background-safe task.

tools.name: code_x_jobs
tools.description: List durable Code-X jobs.

tools.name: code_x_job_status
tools.description: Read one durable Code-X job record.

tools.name: ux_status
tools.description: Check UX-X design-authority runtime, security mode and capabilities.

tools.name: ux_project_scan
tools.description: Read-only scan of a frontend repository and detected UI stack.

tools.name: ux_project_manifest
tools.description: Read package scripts, dependency inventory and UI entry hints without modifying the repository.

tools.name: ux_component_inventory
tools.description: Inventory UI files and detectable component families across legacy and component-based frontends.

tools.name: ux_design_system_audit
tools.description: Audit CSS tokenization, color/spacing/radius/font literals, breakpoints, focus-visible, RTL and reduced-motion signals.

tools.name: ux_audit
tools.description: Static read-only UI/UX heuristic audit for responsiveness, accessibility and component quality.

tools.name: ux_runtime_preflight
tools.description: Check whether the project has the local Playwright/axe prerequisites for rendered QA.

tools.name: ux_runtime_audit
tools.description: Run allowlisted rendered Playwright QA on mobile and desktop, capturing overflow, console errors, axe findings and screenshots outside the project.

tools.name: ux_test_plan
tools.description: Generate the deterministic responsive/accessibility/interaction test matrix.

tools.name: ux_quality_gate
tools.description: Apply UX-X release gates. Without a runtime URL, rendered gates are BLOCKED rather than falsely passing.

tools.name: ux_change_spec
tools.description: Generate a prioritized P0/P1 change specification for Code-X, preserving the target project visual identity unless redesign is explicit.

tools.name: ux_kit_catalog
tools.description: Return UX-X's curated professional UI/UX kit catalog. Advisory only; never installs packages.

tools.name: ux_kit_recommend
tools.description: Recommend compatible UI/UX kits for a scanned project while preserving the existing component system. Read-only.

tools.name: ux_research_skill_catalog
tools.description: List UX-X external design-research skills (Dribbble, Mobbin, Behance) and their guardrails.

tools.name: ux_research_skill_resolve
tools.description: Rank UX-X external design-research skills for a design-research context.

tools.name: ux_safe_patch_plan
